decision: Script v1 drafted from the 3 m2 home-design reference: narrated build-up, one element per caption line, scan build then SEMA parts designed on the scan
why: User wants a reusable promo script approved before any 3D/audio work; every line traced to a Drive file, no numbers on screen

decision: Built PromoCaption Remotion comp (white bubble measured off the reference) and captions.json from the approved script
why: Owner: promos are their own format with the reference's white caption bubble, not ScanHUD

decision: Script approved with year 2026; production blocked in this session: no Drive credentials, Blender download host 403, Dropbox download hosts not allowed
why: Default environment is limited network with no GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON; the Illumaesthetic Cloud environment has both but a running session can't move onto an unrestricted environment

decision: Voice: Higgsfield seed_audio preset 'Grady' (male), whole script in one take; no music
why: Owner: any voice, music not necessary; preset voice, not a clone of a real person

decision: Voice: kept the Grady take for 19 lines; re-recorded 'let's build a 2026 nissan sentra SR' and 'even the brake adapters' (same preset, padded with 'Okay.' and cut out)
why: speech-to-text (whisper small+medium) heard 'brake adapts' in the take and the take started mid-phoneme (-19 dB at sample 0); the re-records transcribe as 'brake adapters' and start/end in silence

decision: Voice track = take segments re-spaced with planned gaps (0.35-0.9 s), 45.6 s; timing.json holds every line window
why: the take's own pauses were uneven and the 'adapters/revised' pair had no pause; gaps are sized to the visual beat each line needs (builds/hood lift get 0.9 s)

decision: Frame: everything rendered in the design frame of 'Sentra Review 3.blend' (scan raw -> design via the file's matrix for 'Bumper Removed (Headlights Back On)')
why: The SEMA CAD STLs are exported in that frame; trimmed ICP of all CAD onto the car moved only 3 mm / 0.27 deg, so the designer's placement is used as-is instead of a new registration

decision: Hero car mesh = full 25 M-tri scan quadric-simplified to 6 M (fast_simplification), ground (z < -26 mm) and debris islands (<3000 faces) removed; no grid decimation
why: A90 lesson: grid clustering leaves stair-step contours on panels; quadric keeps the scan's own surface

decision: Hook = IMG_3229 0-4.33 s (finished SEMA car, front 3/4, hood ducts + bumper + fog pocket), voice only; hard 1:1 cut at 4.333 s to the same camera, hand-matched by onion overlay of the CAD bumper/ducts (within ~30 px at 540 wide)
why: Script: real car, then a hard cut to the void in the same perspective; the CAD parts ARE the parts on the real car, so they are the landmarks. The void shot drops the SEMA front bumper exactly where the real one sat

decision: Engine bay beat = scan-line sweep along the hood: front of the car swaps to 'Senta SR Sentra Engine Bay' (hood-off capture) behind the line, and sweeps back on 'now we design on top of it'
why: That scan registers onto the car with the same matrix and was captured with the hood off; a hinge animation would invent an open hood state

decision: Fog lights = 'Sentra Fog 1/2' bench scans: fly in and park in front of the nose, then seat behind the rectangular lamp frames of the SEMA fog/duct inserts before the inserts click in
why: No data says where the lamps sit in the STOCK bumper; the Sep 16 'Fog/Duct reprint' inserts have an 85x55 mm lamp frame and the real SEMA car shows the small lamp there. Lamp pose = PCA lens axis forward, centred on the measured hole (tools/fogplace.py)

decision: Stock bumper off = loose 'Senta SR bumper only' scan slides forward and drops away; base = car minus triangles lying on that scan (<= 6 mm) + 'Bumper Removed' state only inside the bumper box below the hood line (tools/bumpercut.py)
why: The bumper-removed state was captured hood-off, so it may only fill the bumper opening; the car keeps its own hood for the hood-duct beat

decision: Brake beat = its own close-up on the 'Senta SR FR Hub' scan as placed in 'Sentra_Brakes_Review.blend': test-fit adapter (STL to test fit, Sep 2) slots on, steps to V3 (Sep 13) then V4 (Sep 16), then rotor + caliper scans go on
why: The hub was captured on the lift (suspension drooped ~115 mm) so it cannot sit in the car scan; V3->V4 differs by only ~2 mm, the Sep 2 test-fit is 6-15 mm thinner - three versions make 'revised until they fit' visible. Rotor goes on last because it hides the seated adapter

decision: Wing beat shows Uncut_Wing_Adapter.stl (the only file in the SEMA 'Wing' folder)
why: The narration 'and a wing' is owner-approved; the wing element itself is not in the files, so only its adapter is shown - flagged in review.md

decision: No music, voice only; IRL natural sound dropped
why: Owner: NO music. Keeping the show-floor crowd under a voice-only promo would read as noise

decision: Fog-lamp beat re-framed: lamps park side by side at x +-0.16 in front of the nose, camera dead ahead (focal 40); frames 257-352 re-rendered
why: v1 parked them 0.9 m apart from a 3/4 camera; the 9:16 frame only spans ~0.6 m there, so one lamp was a speck at the edge and the other off-frame during 'and the fog lights'

decision: Delivered v1: 47.0 s, voice only, captions from the cut on, logo card 43.43-47.0
